name: DADA-2000
summary: 面向驾驶事故预测与驾驶员注意分析的行车视频数据集，包含事故发生前后的连续片段和注意/显著性相关标注。
summaryEn: A dashcam-video dataset for driving accident prediction and driver-attention analysis, containing continuous clips around accidents with attention and saliency-related annotations.
licenseZh: 数据集条款需进一步核查
access: Official GitHub repository provides DADA resources and benchmark code
accessZh: 官方 GitHub 仓库提供 DADA 资源和基准代码
verdict: 事故发生前状态演化和注意线索
verdictEn: Pre-accident state evolution and attention cues
wmNote: 事故发生前的视频上下文可用于测试未来危险状态预测；类别偏向事故场景，正常驾驶覆盖有限。
wmNoteEn: Pre-accident video context supports future hazard prediction tests, while the distribution is accident-heavy and has limited normal-driving coverage.
